pre_reflection.text:
[Pre-reflection] Potential weaknesses include whipsaws from narrow Keltner bands, RSI divergence risks, and potential ATR scaling with price. Also, mean-reversion struggles in strong trending markets.
[Backup plan] If performance is poor: widen Keltner rescale ATR to price, adjust RSI thresholds. If mediocre: optimize period, add volume filter, consider stochastic RSI. Alternative: switch to momentum strategy with trailing stop.
